messages.content:
Risk: Compromise of privacy
Description: AI systems that memorize and leak sensitive personal data or infer private information about individuals without their consent. Unexpected or unauthorized sharing of data and information can compromise user expectation of privacy, assist identity theft, or loss of confidential intellectual property.
Concern: None
Policy: Protected Health Information and Data Privacy

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000030: information content entity — A generically dependent continuant that is about some thing. [found by 6/18 queries]
  Siblings: Information Content Entity, normal value
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000027: data item — a data item is an information content entity that is intended to be a truthful statement about something (modulo, e.g., measurement precision or other systematic errors) and is constructed/acquired by a method which reliably tends to produce (approximately) truthful statements. [found by 6/18 queries]
  Siblings: DIPS question, directive information entity, patient symptom report
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination. [found by 11/18 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure — Disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as names, addresses, government identifiers, or biometric data. [found by 11/18 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure — Disclosure of personal financial information including account numbers, credit scores, or transaction histories without authorization. [found by 11/18 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure

axes.rationale: This class represents the core nature of the risk—the unauthorized disclosure or use of information. It serves as a primary axis to vary the type of privacy breach occurring (e.g., collection vs. disclosure).

This axis allows for variation in the specific type of sensitive data being leaked, focusing on information that directly identifies an individual, which is a key component of the privacy compromise risk.

This provides a specific dimension of data type (financial information) that can be targeted or leaked, allowing for diverse prompt generation regarding different categories of sensitive personal data.
